tooltip.meproxy.me_proxy.usage: Exposes the whole ME network as a plain inventory for pipes, Create, or an RS External Storage
tooltip.meproxy.network_bridge: Bridges an ME network and a Refined Storage network
tooltip.meproxy.network_bridge.usage: Place touching an ME cable and an RS cable. Both networks then see, store, and use each other's items and fluids. Autocrafting stays separate. Use one bridge per network pair.
tooltip.meproxy.universal_grid.usage: Place touching a Network Bridge. Shows items per network, crafts on either side, and tracks bridge stats.
